note: TikTok: SCALE_CANDIDATE (LTV:CAC 2.03x, M6 37.5%, CPAO $143). META: HOLD (LTV:CAC 0.48x, between 0.20-0.50 HOLD band, CPAO $666).

channels.narrative_rationale:
TikTok is the strongest-performing channel by unit economics. The deterministic policy
assigned SCALE_CANDIDATE because LTV:CAC ratio of 2.03x exceeded the 1.0x threshold
and CPAO efficiency is well above baseline. TikTok's low CPM ($5) drives high reach
per dollar, producing 262 activated owners at a CPAO of $143 — the lowest across all
channels. These metrics were computed by the policy engine — this narrative does not
alter them.
channels.tradeoff:
Scaling TikTok spend will increase absolute spend and require additional creative
production to avoid ad fatigue on a frequency-sensitive platform. The gain is a
lower blended CPAO and a higher proportion of high-LTV owners in the acquired cohort.
channels.risk:
TikTok's algorithm is opaque and audience reach for the restaurant owner segment is
narrower than Meta. Over-scaling into a shallow audience pool risks CPM inflation and
CTR decay. Creative refresh cadence must be maintained to sustain performance.
channels.next_experiment_hypothesis:
Hypothesis: A SOCIAL_PROOF hook featuring real independent restaurant owners on TikTok
will improve 14-day activation rate by 15+ percentage points versus the current
CONTRAST hook control.
variable_tested: hook_type
primary_metric: cpao_usd
guardrail_metric: m1_retention_rate
minimum_trials: 300

channels.narrative_rationale:
META is held due to weak unit economics relative to spend. The deterministic policy
assigned HOLD because LTV:CAC ratio of 0.48x falls below the 0.50x OBSERVE threshold,
making it ineligible for scaling. META receives 40% of total budget but produces only
90 activated owners at a CPAO of $666 — 4.7x more expensive than TikTok. Despite
receiving the highest absolute spend ($59,974), META produces the fewest activated
owners. These metrics were computed by the policy engine — this narrative does not
alter them.
channels.tradeoff:
Maintaining minimal META spend preserves retargeting reach and brand visibility for
restaurant owners who discovered Tablr through other channels. Cutting META entirely
removes a full-funnel channel that may contribute to assisted conversions.
channels.risk:
Continuing META spend without improvement risks budget dilution. META's high CPM ($18)
relative to TikTok ($5) means fewer impressions per dollar, fewer clicks, and fewer
signups — the reversal story is structural, not creative-driven alone.
channels.next_experiment_hypothesis:
Hypothesis: A DEMONSTRATION hook on META (showing the Tablr dashboard setup process)
will reduce trial CAC by 20%+ versus the current CONTRAST hook, by targeting owners
who are in active evaluation mode rather than awareness mode.
variable_tested: hook_type
primary_metric: trial_cac_usd
guardrail_metric: m1_retention_rate
minimum_trials: 200
